title: 3D Reference, Pose/Scene Staging & Line Extraction
objective: Allow governed 3D/Scene/Character reference staging for camera, pose, hand/head/body reference, props and backgrounds, plus non-authoritative image/3D-to-line or tone proposals where existing renderers support them. Reference staging never becomes Character/Scene truth.
acceptance: 3D, Scene and Character reference staging binds to existing governed owner identities and versions rather than creating duplicate Character, Scene or asset truth.
Camera, pose, hand/head/body, prop and background reference state remains explicit authoring reference/staging metadata.
Existing renderer or production primitive owners are consumed where available; SAA does not create a duplicate generic 3D renderer or scene engine.
Image/3D-to-line or tone results are explicit non-authoritative proposals with source/reference lineage and cannot silently replace editable drawing/layer state.
Reference staging never mutates canonical Character pose/appearance, Scene placement or narrative truth.
SAA-24 ARI material/provenance and SAA-23 drawing/layer authority boundaries remain sealed.
Provider-off/local authoring remains valid when governed local reference assets/renderers are available.
SAA-26 and later webtoon/print/multimedia/interchange/publication behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-25 owns comic-authoring reference/staging semantics only; canonical Character, Scene, asset/material and renderer authority remains with existing owners.
Line/tone extraction outputs remain proposals until explicitly accepted through governed SAA drawing/edit authority.
No duplicate Character, Scene, ARI, renderer, 3D engine or narrative ledger may be created.
No proprietary vendor code, private formats, assets, protected expression or undocumented protocols may be copied.
Provider-off/local operation remains valid where governed local capabilities exist.
SAA-26 remains blocked until verified SAA-25 closeout.
